prompt: Modern 3D animated character group shot, Pixar style, diverse group of animated kid characters different genders playing together, stylized, vibrant colors, cinematic 3D render, include a title

plan.rationale: This design aims to capture a vibrant and inclusive group of animated kids playing, in a style reminiscent of Pixar's cheerful and diverse characters. The title will be modern and clean, with a slight 3D effect to match the overall aesthetic. The composition will feature a diverse group of characters, each with unique but harmonious facial expressions and body languages, playing in a stylized, colorful setting to emphasize the fun and camaraderie among them.

elements.content: A diverse group of animated kids, including a boy, a girl, and a child of a non-binary gender, playing in a park setting with a colorful, stylized 3D background. They are engaged in various activities like building a sandcastle, playing catch, and laughing together.
